method: Photo-background samples at non-space character centers, or the immediate graphite halo where a 2px centered stroke is painted behind the unchanged fill. Alpha-composited computed text color; decorative aria-hidden arrows excluded. Normal text 4.5:1, large/bold text 3:1. Not a full accessibility audit.
